metadata.title: विलेज काउंसिल चुनाव पर क्या बोले बिकास देब बर्मा | Tribal Development in Tripura | Bikas Debbarma
metadata.description: In this interview, we speak with the Tribal Affairs Minister of Tripura State about the government's efforts to improve the lives of the tribal population in the state. The minister claims that the government has taken several steps to provide better education, healthcare, and infrastructure facilities to tribal areas. However, our reporters on the ground say that there is still a scarcity of water, electricity, and health facilities in these areas. Watch the interview to learn more about the minister's perspective on the situation and the steps taken by the government to address these challenges.
